hints.title: Algebraic Sequence Sum
hints.text: Express the sum of k consecutive integers starting from x algebraically and check divisibility.

hints.title: Arithmetic Progression Formula
hints.text: The sum of k terms starting at x is k * x + k * (k - 1) / 2 = n.

hints.title: Bounded Square Root Iteration
hints.text: Iterate term count k starting from 1 while k * (k - 1) / 2 < n. Whenever (n - k * (k - 1) / 2) is divisible by k, increment the valid representation count.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Iterates k while k * (k - 1) / 2 < N in O(sqrt(N)) steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating consecutive sums directly takes O(N) or O(N^2) time and causes timeout.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulate n = k*x + k*(k-1)/2 and bound search to sqrt(2*n).
